must_pass.check: company objective and owning business/process role are identified or explicitly UNKNOWN
material company facts resolve to a source-of-truth/source owner rather than AI memory alone
tool/connectivity capability is kept separate from decision/action authority
company-private data and credentials are not written to shared base_core
first integration uses the smallest useful process/source/tool set
read/draft is preferred before higher-risk write/execute when practical
production writes, sends, payments, deployments or commitments have explicit scoped approval
readiness and HOLD are local/dependency-specific rather than global when possible
productivity/value claims remain estimates until a company KPI baseline and pilot delta exist
scale follows verified delta, stable observability and a known recovery/rollback path

fail_closed: If company authority, source ownership, privacy, connection scope or measurable pilot criteria are unclear, keep the affected lane READ_ONLY/DRAFT/HOLD and continue independent safe work where possible.
